description.value: The Salted Vine Kitchen + Bar occupies Squamish's oldest surviving building, a 1910 structure at the corner of Second and Victoria, outfitted with modern-country farmhouse décor of reclaimed poplar panels, grey teak tables, and custom-milled maple accents. The menu centres on sustainably sourced, seasonal Pacific Northwest ingredients—fresh daily oysters, BC salmon, handcrafted cocktails, and an extensive wine list—making it one of the most refined dining stops on the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. A 70-seat dining room and lounge is complemented by a 20-seat patio.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and current (© 2025), providing strong primary evidence. Takeout is explicitly offered and a dedicated Gluten Free Menu plus vegetarian menu items are listed, supporting those amenity values as true. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure is mentioned on the site or in OSM tags; OSM's wheelchair=yes and toilets:wheelchair=yes tags confirm accessible on-site washrooms for the full-service dine-in restaurant.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'The Salted Vine' but the website consistently uses the full trading name 'The Salted Vine Kitchen + Bar'.
OSM phone field is empty; (604) 390-1910 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established upscale restaurant in downtown Squamish on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor with takeout and wheelchair-accessible facilities; a clear benefit to touring cyclists.
